classes.definition: Generated by a declared physical, statistical, or numerical model without fitting to the record being evaluated.
restrictions: Must name the model, version, assumptions, and parameter sources.
Must not be described as measured or experimentally validated.

classes.definition: Reported by an external publication or curated source and imported without fitting to this study's experimental records.
restrictions: Must preserve a resolvable source or local database record identifier.
Applicability to the current material form and environment must be stated.

classes.definition: Measured on study hardware or calibration standards and designated in advance as an input to the model.
restrictions: Acquisition conditions, units, uncertainty, and raw-data reference are required.
Calibration records cannot also be counted as held-out validation.

classes.definition: Estimated from development or calibration data by a declared fitting or inference procedure.
restrictions: Training data, fitting procedure, parameter uncertainty, and fit scope are required.
A fitted value cannot be presented as independent validation.

classes.definition: Measured or simulated record sequestered from fitting, threshold selection, and design ranking until the declared evaluation.
restrictions: Must identify the freeze point and access policy.
Any use for model or threshold changes retires the record from held-out status.
